scope: Geometry remaining circle relation, point location, orientation, point-segment distance, segment intersection, triangle area full/split
independent_reference: Boost cpp_int determinants, segment incidence and intersections; rational ray crossing parity for simple monotone/concave polygons; independent shoelace area; Boost cpp_dec_float_100 clamped-projection point-segment distance and circle squared-distance classification. Product implementation does not appear in the oracle.
boundary_cases: all 9^4 endpoint combinations on a 3x3 grid, integer and floating eps=0 intersections, returned intersection point incidence
native-128 10,000 random wide int64 four-point sets within documented arithmetic limits
empty/1/2/repeated/concave polygons, clockwise/counterclockwise, boundary and outside points
zero-length closed segment, endpoint/interior distances; scales 1e-200 through 1e200; representable coordinates whose unscaled direction norm overflows
zero radius, coincident positive circles, tangent/two intersections/nonintersection, almost concentric and epsilon boundary; residuals to both circles
invalid circle radius and nonfinite center in checked mode; direct validate remains active with SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS
allocation-free circle_intersection_kind and triangle area scalar APIs; result vectors retain ownership
new_apis: global circle_intersection_kind(a,b,eps): same classification as geo::intersection, no intersection-vector allocation
global signed_triangle_area2(a,b,c) and triangle_area(a,b,c): scalar triangle area, no vector construction
actual_submit_code: Final library expanded using Scripts/prepare_verify.py render into temporary files. Shared main and common fast I/O unchanged. Repository submission/manifest synchronization and distribution ZIP are handled by the parent task.
submission_status: オンライン未提出。今回のローカル照合をACと表記しない。過去の判定記録を変更しない。
standard_fallback_limit: Fallback coordinates and cumulative values must fit std::int64_t. Native-only wide cases are excluded in this configuration rather than invoking signed overflow.
exception_limit: Existing low-cost validation scope is retained. Finite coordinates and representable intermediate arithmetic remain preconditions. Not all unreferenced invalid input is inspected.

reproduce.axes: Repeat with clang++, -DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS, -DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC. The Boost development headers are needed only by the reference test.
